# Studying economic change as it unfolds

::: {.lead}
TIDE Lab brings together researchers studying how technology, migration, demography, and education reshape economies, labour markets, and public policy.
:::

::: {.hero-actions}
[Explore our research](research.qmd){.button-primary}
[Meet the team](people/index.qmd){.button-secondary}
:::
:::

## Four connected research themes

Our work starts from the premise that technology, population movements, demographic change, and education cannot be understood in isolation. TIDE creates a common space for evidence-driven research across these fields.

::: {.lab-grid}
::: {.lab-card}
::: {.card-number}
T
:::
### Technology

Technological adoption, productivity, work, skills, and the distribution of economic opportunity.
:::

::: {.lab-card}
::: {.card-number}
I
:::
### Immigration

Migration decisions, integration, labour-market adjustment, and the economic effects of mobility.
:::

::: {.lab-card}
::: {.card-number}
D
:::
### Demography

Population ageing, fertility, household formation, and intergenerational change.
:::

::: {.lab-card}
::: {.card-number}
E
:::
### Education

Education, skills, human-capital formation, intergenerational mobility, and equality of opportunity.
:::
:::

## A new research community in Istanbul

TIDE Lab is based at **Istanbul Medeniyet University**. Our first release introduces the lab and its research agenda; projects, working papers, events, and research resources will be added as the programme develops.

::: {.tide-note}
**Interested in our work?** Visit the [contact page](contact.qmd) to reach the lab or explore our public work on [GitHub](https://github.com/tide-policy-lab).
:::
